In this capacity, the Coordinator, Finance will:
Take ownership of maintaining the Timekeeper, Client, and Matter master tables in the Firm's accounting system (3E): Set up Effective Dated Records within all 3 maintenance tables; Lead management and reconciliation of the Firm's timekeeping system and time corrections with the IT department; Drive updates and creation of new clients and matters within 3E using the [Product name masked] Intake system; Direct updates to Billing and eBilling assignments in coordination with the Billing Team; Set up and maintain PTA/Task/Activity codes for Client Matters; Execute adjustments to time entries and record time corrections as needed; Ensure Billing and eBilling assignments are current in coordination with the Billing Team; Pull Disbursement and Invoice Backup; Maintain Proforma Tracker CSS assignments; Manage billing attorney assignment updates (delivered to both Billing and the Time departments); Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) during system upgrades and implementations; Work overtime as required, in particular at month end and year end; and Handle additional related projects as assigned.
cond_0206.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Good verbal and written communications skills
Ability to input information accurately into various systems
Ability to multitask, organize, and prioritize work
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
Bachelor's degree
At least 2 years of accounting experience
Preferred Requirements:
Advanced proficiencies in Excel and 10 key
Fundamental knowledge of 3E and Word
cond_0206.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.
